stage: host_sequence_triage_before_training; phage exclusion specification still pending
host_similarity_method: skani 0.4.0, default dist estimator, c=125, m=1000, screen=80, min-af=15, threads=4

host_exclusion.unresolved_or_boundary_pairs: exclude pending base-level alignment review; never silently retain a missing comparison

rationale: 99.5% ANI is a conservative within-species genomic-unit exclusion, not an E. coli strain identity definition
90% reciprocal alignment fraction and boundary buffers are explicit project policies, not calibrated confidence intervals
95% species ANI would exclude the species-wide training domain rather than just near-target backgrounds
ANI and core-genome patristic distances are different metrics; do not equate this with the original 1e-4 core-distance split
This rule is fixed without target model results; do not relax it to improve future performance

phage_policy_status: unresolved before training: whole-genome grouping and gp17 similarity must be specified and audited separately
limits: A passed host triage is not proof of no shared receptor determinants, authentic experimental stocks, strain-specific prediction or assembly compatibility
